en-IN.name: CrewOps
en-IN.summary: Airline crew control: what is waiting on your desk, and legal cover for a sick call.
en-IN.description: CrewOps answers crew-control questions with legally checked, cost-ranked cover, and tells a controller's Echo when a disruption reaches their desk.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask crew ops what's waiting
Alexa, ask crew ops tell me who covers P 2291
